name: 結華
text:
やっちゃったなぁ……。ごめんねプロデューサー、
せっかくレッスン入れてもらったのに……
trans:
I done goofed... I'm sorry, Producer.
After you went out of your way to let me do those
lessons, too...

name: 結華
text:
三峰、上手くできなかったよ
……次までにはなんとかするから待ってて！
trans:
Mitsumine didn't do so well this time, huh.
...I'll do whatever I can to make sure it doesn't
happen again, just you wait!
